newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: McPherson's sees growth, to resume div.
newsitem.headline: McPherson's sees growth, to resume div.

text.p: Homewares manufacturer McPherson's Ltd said on Wednesday that its earnings outlook for the 1996/97 financial year and beyond was positive with the prospect of sustained profit growth coming from increased sales and further improvement in margins.
The company also said it planned to resume paying dividends commencing with an interim dividend in 1997.
Earlier, McPherson's announced a net profit of A$9.01 million for the year to June 30, 1996 compared to a loss of A$31.39 million in the previous year.
